title: Rescope or close djo (Phase 5b): its Claude half shipped as jvj + v5t
body:
Epic djo (subscription seats as flat-rate credentials, via omp's auth broker) predates jvj's spike and v5t, which deliver the Claude half differently: a factory-held CLAUDE_SUB_TOKEN_<LABEL> with leases and a Workers AI step-down, no broker. What remains is Codex/ChatGPT seats and the broker question. An operator decision: rescope djo to Codex seats on v5t's rung design, or close it.
evidence: .tick/issues/djo.json; docs/spikes/jvj-claude-sub-cloud.md; .tick/runners.cloud.toml [configs.claude]
